The gap figures are what stutter is made of: a p95 far
above 16.7 ms means frames arrive in bursts, and no
amount of decoding speed can smooth that out.

The drift figures can go NEGATIVE, and that is not a bug:
the two clocks are anchored on the first frame and only
their DIFFERENCE is reported, so a first frame that was
unusually slow makes every later one look early. It says
how transit CHANGED, never how long it takes.
